items.title: Should CEO Change Require Action From Home Depot Stock Investors?
items.summary: Home Depot reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$43,398 million and net income of US$3,713 million, alongside updated 2026 guidance that calls for total sales growth of approximately 4.5% and diluted EPS growth of about 1.5% from US$14.23 in fiscal 2025. The board moved to concentrate experience at the top by naming long-time CFO Richard McPhail as CEO, adding him to the board, elevating veteran operator Ann-Marie Campbell to President and COO, and appointing digital and finance insider...
